Notes: Fadi took us from the end of the loose traverse all the way to the bottom of the gully and Rebuffat's Arete. I took us from there to the summit! That last crack to the top is so killer, oh my god. Sewed it up with nuts just to make the climbing last longer! Shiver belay while Fadi did his monster linkup, then the sun came out at the top :)

Holy sandbag onsight, Batman! I was quaking in my damn boots at the crux, it was so thin. Fadi saved me from pulling way too hard by telling me to go right instead of tackling the 11-something bulge on the left. What a gentleman. One pitch from the ground all the way to the big rap bolt on Rewritten!

Fadi set me up by climbing one long pitch all the way to the bottom of the crux crack! I had to fiddle around with one section at the start of the standard P2 because the movement was weird and he plugged a #3 in my jam lmao. The crux pitch was SO sweet!! Sinker jams the entire way, just don't hang out too long or you might get pumped
Came back for the whole enchilada with Fadi! I got the money pitch since I'd already led P1 1 with Kim, and wow it was SO incredible!!! Kinda a lot of bird shit at the top though. Awesome day out!!
